name: Winter fens NL 1129AM Kampina Kogelvangersven 230214_0559
description: A very calm heather landscape with fens surrounded by mixed forest on a winter day in February. National Park Kampina in the south of the Netherlands. It's wonderfully quiet here. There are countless birds in the trees and the water that suspect spring on this sunny February day. More recordings here during the year's / More here today Date/time: February 14th 2023, start 11:29 am Weather: 2-8c, clear sky, clouds 0%, wind SSE 1-2 bft 5km/h with gusts to 8 kmh, 1034 hPa, humidity 85-85%.
